title: fix(search-box): fix magnifier and reset customization
body:
<!--
  Thanks for submitting a pull request!

-->

**Summary**

Fix the magnifier and reset options of the search-box widget:
 - the ``reset: false`` option currently breaks. The renderer tries to hide the button even when it does not exist.
 - custom templates are not taken into account for both options, despite the documentation saying otherwise.

<!--

**Result**

Fixed the problems and added the related tests.
